# Display snippets for docs/lambdas.md

--8<-- [start:call_goal_examples]
# lambda receives X = 5
call_goal((X <- (X > 0)), 5)

# lambda receives X = 5, Y = RESULT
call_goal(((X, Y) <- (Y == X * 2)), 5, RESULT)
--8<-- [end:call_goal_examples]

--8<-- [start:compilation_example]
(X, Y) <- (Y == X + Z)
--8<-- [end:compilation_example]

--8<-- [start:builtin_as_goal]
# Builtin predicates can be passed directly — no lambda needed
all_numbers(XS) <- maplist(number, XS)
keep_ints(XS, IS) <- include(integer, XS, IS)
incremented(XS, YS) <- maplist(succ, XS, YS)
--8<-- [end:builtin_as_goal]
